stem.text: A diffraction grating experiment is set up using orange light of wavelength $600\,\text{nm}$. The grating has a slit separation of $2.00\,\mu\text{m}$.

stem.alt: Grating with light of wavelength 600 nm arriving from the left, two diverging rays labelled 1st order orange and 2nd order orange, and angles theta 1 and theta 2 measured from a dashed horizontal line.

stem.text: What is the angular separation $(\theta_{2} - \theta_{1})$ between the first and second order maxima of the orange light?
